editor_of_record.name: Dinis Cruz
editor_of_record.what: Reviews every page before it publishes, and is the named human answerable for what this publication says.
editor_of_record.answers: Open question 5 of the 12 May 2026 newsroom brief — who is the editor of record, and who carries legal responsibility for published content — which that brief left open and which this site called the one it should be most uncomfortable about.
editor_of_record.limit: A named editor of record is a person taking responsibility. It is not a legal opinion, and no legal review has been done. The publication reports what other organisations have published and links to it.

note: Seven agent roles and one named human. The posture differs deliberately from The Governance Wire, which is fully agentic with nobody reviewing before publication: this beat is about named people and named companies in a small ecosystem, where being wrong in public costs somebody other than us.

inherits_from.brief: The 12 May 2026 Portuguese Newsroom Workflow brief, which specified eleven roles
inherits_from.what: The role split and the humans-are-the-bar doctrine. Four of the eleven are not built here and are listed as absent rather than quietly dropped.

roles.name: Researcher
roles.gravity: No claim without bytes we hold.
roles.owns: The ingestion path: fetch, freeze to a dated snapshot, hash, record retrieval time.
roles.refuses: Reading a source over the network at publish time; citing a page nobody froze.
roles.wrong_when: A claim cannot be walked back to a SHA-256 in the register.

roles.name: Extractor
roles.gravity: The graph says what the frozen copy says, and nothing more.
roles.owns: Typed entities from frozen bytes; the speaker and organisation nodes.
roles.refuses: Extracting from the live site; tidying a messy source value into a cleaner one.
roles.wrong_when: A node disagrees with the frozen page it names.

roles.name: Cartographer
roles.gravity: The map is closeable, or it is not a map.
roles.owns: Coverage: which entities on this beat are known, and which are known to be missing.
roles.refuses: Reporting a count as complete when the source is still changing.
roles.wrong_when: The map implies completeness the snapshots do not support.

roles.name: Diff Watch
roles.owns: Comparison between snapshots: added, removed, edited, and the hashes on both sides.
roles.refuses: Explaining a removal. The diff is published; the reason is left blank unless a source states it.
roles.wrong_when: A change is reported with a motive attached to it.

roles.name: Writer
roles.gravity: Every sentence traces to a node.
roles.owns: Story markdown and the node ids each story stands on.
roles.refuses: A claim with no backing node; adjectives about people.
roles.wrong_when: The prose is more certain than the snapshots are.

roles.name: Editor
roles.gravity: The publication's voice, and the things it will not say.
roles.owns: The refusal list and the disclaimers.
roles.refuses: Any adverse characterisation of a named person or company; any inference about why somebody left a list.
roles.wrong_when: Something published would embarrass a named individual on evidence this thin.

roles.name: Publisher
roles.gravity: Versions are promises, and a beta says so on its face.
roles.owns: The section version, the release note, the beta notice, the gates.
roles.refuses: Shipping without the beta notice or without the editor of record having read it.
roles.wrong_when: A reader takes the publication for more finished than it is.

not_built.why: Multi-day investigative work. Nothing on this beat has needed it yet, and claiming it would be claiming a capability.
Portuguese is structurally supported and not yet published. See the language note on the about page.
No infographics are generated. The only images on this site are screenshots of its own interfaces.
The per-reader projection layer in the original brief. Not built, and not needed before an audience exists.
No audience to monitor yet. Building a response loop before there are responses would be theatre.
